products.name: Thermometer (ME Equipment)
products.essential_performance: Limits of the error of the thermometer

semantic_fragments.content: EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE stated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE as 5 years. This is per Clause 4.4 of IEC60601-1.

No alternative means of addressing particular RISKS were provided or used. Per Clause 4.5, alternative means must be justified by the MANUFACTURER showing RESIDUAL RISKS are comparable to those resulting from standard requirements, based on scientific data, clinical opinion, or comparative studies.

No COMPONENT WITH HIGH-INTEGRITY CHARACTERISTICS was used in this ME EQUIPMENT per Clause 4.9. No evaluation of such components for conditions of use and reasonably foreseeable misuse during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE was required.

All components and wiring are used within their specified ratings. Reliability of components used as MEANS OF PROTECTION was assessed for conditions of use in ME EQUIPMENT. Components complied with applicable safety requirements of relevant IEC or ISO standards (see appended table 8.10).
